title: docs(comments): retire the present-tense platform-admin elevation gate at the sites #13903 scoped
body:
Part of #13903 — deliberately **not** a closing keyword. Six of the card's seven rows are complete; the seventh is complete except for one listed line that turns out to be an `it()` **title** rather than a comment, which this PR's tier cannot take. See "The one row left half-taken" below. The PM re-grades.

Comment-only. Zero behaviour change. The #11663 platform-admin re-anchor (legs L2 and L4, both landed) retired the walled platform-admin **elevation gate**: under a walled posture `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` writes no grant row and elevates nobody — it reports. Standing is derived per request at `resolve-authz-context.ts` §6b-config, from a config-anchored verified email or the legacy unscoped grant row.

## Premise re-verified against today's `origin/main`, not the card's transcription

The card measured at `46b53a25b`; this branch is cut from `9b18c0475`. Every quoted line was re-read in the tree before editing and every one is still there, at line numbers that moved by at most a few. Two premise details did **not** survive, and both are recorded rather than papered over:

- **The card is right that `platform-admin.ts:287` is stale only in its NAME, but the supporting detail is stale too.** `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` no longer emits `walled_owner_not_registered` / `walled_owner_not_verified`. Its walled arm returns `reason: 'walled_owner_email_undeclared'` or `'walled_config_derived'` (`grep -n "reason: '"` on that file lists exactly seven reasons and neither of those two is among them; `walled-bootstrap-stops-granting.md` records the replacement, and `bootstrap-platform-admin-walled-owner.test.ts:161` says "formerly `walled_owner_not_registered`"). **The reasoning survives and is kept**, as the card requires: the two halves are still separate answers, now as the `registered` and `verified` fields of `PlatformAdminStandingEntry`, which is what lets the boot log print "not registered yet" apart from "registered, NOT verified". The corrected comment names that, and names the retired pair as its ancestor.
- **`env.ts:169` is now `:165-175`** and reads "the elevation refusal in plugin-security's `bootstrapPlatformAdmin`". What that site actually holds today is the fail-closed backstop for an undeclared or refused config (`:424`) plus the config-derived standing log (`:457`) — neither is an elevation refusal.

## The seven rows, one at a time

The card filed itself to prevent a global search-and-replace, so each row got its own reading.

1. **`packages/types/src/env.ts`** (docblock over the exported `PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL_ENV`, ships in `@objectstack/types`' `.d.ts`) — wrong about the mechanism. The parenthetical now names what those two message sites really are, and a `⚠️` paragraph states the retirement and where standing comes from instead.
2. **`packages/core/src/security/platform-admin.ts:117`** (`declaredSpellings`) — the referent moved, not the fact. The two-spelling `sys_user` lookup is real and lives in `resolvePlatformAdminStanding` (`plugin-security/platform-admin-service.ts`, verified by reading it: it queries `new Set([email, declaredSpelling])` and then matches by `normalizePlatformAdminEmail`). The comment now names that function and says it inherited the discipline from the retired gate.
3. **`packages/core/src/security/platform-admin.ts:287`** — ⚠️ the row the card singled out. The name is replaced, the **paragraph is kept**: it still says the two halves must stay SEPARATE and now says why in today's terms (`registered` / `verified` as independent per-entry fields, and the operator log that depends on them), with the retired reason-code pair named as history.
4. **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.ts:37-39`** — "the gate must elevate" described an action nothing performs. The third site is now the derivation (`resolve-authz-context.ts` §6b-config, through `matchesConfiguredPlatformAdmin`), and the MUST-agree requirement is restated unchanged. This also removes a self-contradiction: `:10-14` of the same docblock already said the elevation twin is retired.
5. **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:5822`** — "the elevation gate's twin" was the twin of a retired thing. Now: the shared predicate in `platform-owner-wall-bypass.ts`, extracted as that twin, whose opposite number since the re-anchor is the per-request derivation.
6. **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.test.ts:1613`** — "un-makes every platform admin in one write" is true for the GRANT anchor only. Corrected the way #13907 corrected the same sentence in the source file, and it now points at `last-admin-guard.re-pricing.test.ts`, which pins both directions. The added sentence also says why this block's refusals are still live: the file declares no owner emails (`git grep OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` in it returns only the new comment line), so the grant anchor is the whole population here.
7. **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts`** — seven of the eight listed lines. The three-layer docblock now names the derivation rather than the gate, and carries an explicit retirement note quoting the implementation file's own `[#11973]` parenthetical — that file already said this and only its test had not caught up. The `:91` note now states today's consequence (born unverified, so the per-request derivation resolves it non-admin and the boot log reports "registered, NOT verified"), and the two inline comments at `:395` / `:443` follow.

## The reverse control the card named

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/platform-admin-service.ts:21` ("the **retired** elevation gate") and `:99` ("the elevation gate **used**") are already correct and are the card's control: a correct edit does not touch them.

```
git diff --name-only | grep -c "platform-admin-service.ts"   ->   0
```

The file is not in the diff at all. Same for `security-plugin.ts:6351-6367`, the fenced face of #13722: the only hunk in that file is `@@ -5822,2 +5822,5 @@`.

## The one row left half-taken, and why

Row 7 lists eight lines. Line 257 (now `:270`) is **not a comment**:

```ts
it('the email comparison MIRRORS the elevation gate: trimmed, case-insensitive, both sides', () => {
```

A test title is a string literal. It survives `removeComments`, so editing it breaks this PR's own acceptance criterion (non-comment diff empty) and the `Clause-②: no` grade that rests on "the whole diff is comments". The corroboration is in this PR's own measurement run: the identical comment filter applied to an unrelated real code commit (`c54d4d3d7`) left 279 non-comment lines, and the first of them is an `it(...)` title rename.

So the line is left untouched, the docblock above it says so in terms, and the title family is filed as **#14046** together with two comment sites the card's table did not scope.

## Zero-behaviour-change measurements

All taken at head `312a60d22`. Every exit code captured before any pipe.

**Non-comment diff is empty**, measured rather than asserted: each of the six files, before and after, run through `ts.transpileModule` with `removeComments: true`. `diff -u` is **0 lines for all six**, and the sha256 of the stripped output is unchanged in every case:

```
0aded016a914cce3a875de0c009e7b81e77273903d025bf1ced8436e315ae541  env.js                              (before AND after)
7aa362c9402b81aa625630f63abc5bf902683641ce914a96d9aca5158bd6aceb  platform-admin.js                   (before AND after)
544eff7b7f44e7e24bbc01fa48a56b1cb8f3a546fef88824202de3656e02e833  platform-owner-wall-bypass.js       (before AND after)
ee8e85d25ba0ae6b2d6a5aa9af8167dd7d0b1f58af03c63a5d5c5350ff352ef6  security-plugin.js                  (before AND after)
0ddeb985d3a7a6c783f05afa4e62849d89dbd20d02e57ae202993d467cf52a93  last-admin-guard.test.js            (before AND after)
9ef783413a9f7cc86097c948a19669d6b663a78fade7a7616df733a99bdd0653  walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.js (before AND after)
```

**Every zero above is a reading, with a same-shaped control that comes back non-zero:**

- *Does the harness see changes at all?* The identical `diff -u` over the **source** pairs of the same six files: 22, 42, 20, 16, 26 and 77 lines. So a zero on the stripped pair is a measurement, not a blind spot.
- *Does the stripper actually strip?* `env.ts` carries 3 `throw` in source and 1 in the stripped output; `security-plugin.ts` 47 and 35. The stripped text is demonstrably not the source.

**A cruder second reading agrees.** Over `git diff -U0` of the six paths: **113** changed lines, and filtering out every line whose content begins with a JSDoc or `//` marker leaves **0**. Control for that filter: the same pipeline over an unrelated real code commit (`git show -U0 c54d4d3d7 -- '*.ts'`) reports 507 changed lines and **279** non-comment residue.

**`throw` census, both directions** — counted with `\bthrow\b` over source and over the comment-stripped output:

| File | Source before to after | Stripped before to after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/types/src/env.ts` | 3 to 3 | 1 to 1 |
| `packages/core/src/security/platform-admin.ts` | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.ts` | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` | 47 to 47 | 35 to 35 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.test.ts` | 8 to 8 | 8 to 8 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/walled-owner-operator-stamp.test.ts` | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 |

**Census of the dead premise**, `git grep -n -i 'elevation gate\|elevation refusal' -- packages`, merge base `9b18c0475` to head `312a60d22`: **20 hits to 14**. All fourteen survivors were read: ten are correct (retired / past tense / the corrections this PR and #13907 wrote) and four are #14046's subject.

**Control-byte self-scan** over the six files: `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` matches nothing (exit 1). Control: the same grep over a file holding one control byte matches (exit 0), so the clean result is a reading.

## Gates

Re-derived from the actual diff, not from the dispatch list: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `312a60d22` — 6 paths, **24 path-matched families** plus 7 more from three convention triggers (edits a test file; edits a file in a package owning an `i18n-extract.config.ts`; carries an ADR-0112 code). **Both output sections were read whole**; the 31 distinct commands were harvested with `--commands` so neither invocation spelling could be dropped. A first derivation printed a STALE TREE warning (`scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs` had moved on `origin/main`); `origin/main` was merged in and the derivation re-run, which is the reading above.

**27 green.** `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:kernel-hook-pairs`, `check:logger-receiver-detach`, `check:objectql-double-limit`, `check:page-declaration-shape`, `check:published-files`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:slot-lookup`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-source-resolution`, `check:where-matcher`, `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-comment-mask-adoption`, `check-cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-keyed-text-bounds`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape`, `check-shard-attestation`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports`, `check-affected-docs`, `check-drift-comment`.

**4 NOT MEASURED — neither a pass nor a red.** Each quoted from the gate's own verdict line, not from a bare exit code:

- `check-test-completeness` (exit 3) — "Nothing was measured: this gate exited before parsing a single summary line". It grades a saved `turbo run test` log and none was named.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3) — "PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no `dist/`". Needs a whole-workspace build.
- `check:type-check-debt` (exit 3) — "`--re-measure` cannot run: 56 workspace dependenc(ies) of the ledgered packages have no built type entry point on disk". Same prerequisite. Its structural half, `check:type-check-coverage`, is green.
- `check:i18n` (exit **1**, and the exit code is the trap here) — its own text is "PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the workspace CLI is not built ... Nothing was checked: no bundle was compared and no config was parsed". Read as NOT MEASURED on the verdict line, never as a red on the code. Its self-test passed. `check:i18n-stale-fill`, which needs no build, is green.

All four want the same thing: a full workspace build. One was attempted under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and completed 31 of 32 turbo tasks in 7m34s before the container's ~10-minute foreground cap killed it (`exit 143`); three further lock acquisitions returned `VERDICT queue-timeout (exit 99)` against a queue that held five other agents' builds and test runs throughout. **Declared narrowing:** these four are left to CI, which builds the workspace as a matter of course. Nothing in this diff can move them — the stripped output is byte-identical, so no `dist/`, no emitted bundle and no ledgered type count can differ.

Beyond the derived family:

- **`pnpm lint`** (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, the whole repo, the unconditional CI step) — **green**, 2m50s. **Not narrowed.**
- Per-package `typecheck` and the two touched test files are the other half of that same narrowing: they need `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` built, which is the lock turn that did not come. Recorded as NOT MEASURED rather than claimed. What a comment edit could plausibly break — an unterminated block comment taking the rest of a file with it — is measured twice over regardless: all six files were **parsed** by `ts.transpileModule` (that is where the byte-identical stripped output comes from) and by ESLint in the green whole-repo run.

## Changeset: `skip-changeset`, deliberately

The label is applied. `skip-changeset` is this repo's exemption for a PR that publishes nothing, and a comments-only diff is on its closed list — the same judgment #13907 made for the same card family. The nuance is real and worth naming: `packages/types` docblocks **do** ship, in `.d.ts`. But what ships there is comment text, not type shape — no type, no exported name, no runtime, no contract moves, and the byte-identical stripped output above is exactly that statement. A changeset here would force a patch release of four packages whose CHANGELOG row could only say "an internal docblock now describes the current mechanism".

## Out of scope, filed

**#14046** — four more sites naming the retired gate: two comment sites the card's table did not scope (`platform-admin.ts:19-21`, the module header of a file this PR does edit elsewhere, and `walled-platform-bucket-diagnostic.test.ts:105`), and the two test TITLES described above, one of which is #13903's own unfinished line. Filed unassigned and unlabelled for triage.
